title: 第一章 女流氓与一平道人

content_zh:
“喂您好！我从报纸上面看到贵公司的招聘信息，请问贵公司……哦！已经满员了啊！那！打扰了，再见！”
“呼——”林铮无奈地长吐了口气挂上电话，然后摊开报纸，在一条招聘广告上打了个叉，可以看到，上面已经有不少的红叉了。一个上午又这么浪费了，林铮有些沮丧，这找份工作就这么难吗？一上午的电话全都招满了，不带这么坑爹的！莫不是那些家伙只是在敷衍他的？嗯，难道非得要亲自上门去应聘才能表现出诚意？既然这样的话，那这些个公司还登这么多招聘信息干嘛？！
一想到这，林铮顿时是满脑子的怨念，而就在林铮腹诽不已的时候，“咔嚓！”的一声，大门被“小林子！快点来帮忙！”突然一阵叫喊声从门口传来，林铮随手放下报纸走了过去，只见门口站着个被箱子挡住了脸，而门口堆放的东西可着实不少，一大堆方便食品，各种日用品。
“你这是准备冬眠还是闭关修炼啊流氓？冬眠的话还早了点，现在可是六月份！？”林铮无语地盯着一地的东西说道。
随着林铮帮忙接过两个箱子，一张白皙的脸蛋便出现在林铮眼前，这是张看上去充满了青春活力的漂亮脸蛋，此时满脸兴奋地喘息着，这姿容绝对是把她自己形象摧毁得是一干二净！就像林铮口中喊的，这会儿她还真像是个女流氓而多过淑女！她，便是杨琪，和林铮居住在一起的好姐妹！由于各种行径在林铮看来实在是和淑女扯不上边，时不时的还口出流氓语录，因而在林铮口中便有了女流氓这个外号，简称流氓！这种外号在别的女孩子听来绝对会暴跳如雷，不过让林铮无语的是，这女流氓还就不在乎了！
杨琪翻了下白眼，“废话少说，赶紧帮忙搬东西，等下你就知道了！”虽然无语，但林铮还是帮着把东西搬了进屋。搬完东西，杨琪一下就钻到沙发里大喘气，随手开了罐果汁就牛饮起来，然后打了个长长的嗝，一点形象都不注意。
“今儿早可真是累死我了！”杨琪喘着气说道，“你是不知道啊！专卖场那是人山人海，差点把我挤成肉饼！不过，嘿嘿——嘿嘿——”
“得，你还是先把气喘好再说吧！”看杨琪那快断气的样儿，林铮还真担心她一口气没过来晕过去。
“至于吗？买啥玩意儿去了累成这样？话说……”林铮扫视了一下杨琪那堪称黄金比例的身材，“这人挤人的，你就不怕被人吃豆腐？！”
“哼——敢吃姑奶奶豆腐的家伙还没出世呢！”杨琪得意洋洋地说道，瞬间，林铮的脑海中便浮现出了某些个被撩阴腿击中的悲催色狼，可以预见，杨琪这趟出去，肯定少不了倒霉的家伙！阿弥陀佛！希望别让人家不能人道了！
林铮为那些想吃女流氓豆腐的色狼默哀了半秒钟，“女英雄威武！不过你到底买什么东西去了你？！”
“当然是好东西！”杨琪又喝了口果汁，气儿是缓过来了，这才得意地对林铮道：“我玩的那个游戏你知道不？”
“你玩的游戏？《幻灵》？知道啊！不是倒闭了嘛！”林铮一脸疑惑。
只见杨琪大腿一拍，兴奋道：“贰了！”
“二了？你这样子看起来是挺二的！”林铮忍不住吐槽了一个。
“你妹！”杨琪吐血，翻了下白眼道：“我的意思是《幻灵贰》出来了！”
“哦？”林铮倒是小小惊讶了一下，“这才倒闭多久，第二代就出来了啊？比起鬼子的《幻想》如何？”
“没法比！”
“那还有什么搞头？没法比还弄出来干嘛？！”
“嘿嘿！”杨琪得意一笑，“这次是反过来了！真想看看那些小鬼子经营商是什么反应！哇哈哈！想想都过瘾啊！这次还不赔死他们！”

“哦！这么牛！”林铮也来兴趣了，“说说，这《幻灵贰》是个什么情况！？”
“两个字，‘真实’！”杨琪道，“第一代还是动漫的画面风格，就咱们国家的动漫水平当然只有被碾压的份，不过这次出来的新系统可是超级现实风格，恩，基本上就像是穿越到了另外一个世界一样！哪是动漫能比得上的！这不，我一早就跑出去把登录设备给买回来了！”说罢，杨琪很是得意地指着刚刚搬进屋的两个箱子道。而听完杨琪的话，林铮也弄明白怎么回事了。

"Hello! I saw your company's recruitment information from the newspaper. May I ask if your company... Oh! It's full! Then! Excuse me, bye!"
"Huh -" Lin Zheng sighed helplessly and hung up the phone, then spread out the newspaper and put a cross on a recruitment advertisement. You can see that there are already a lot of red crosses on it. Lin Zheng was a little frustrated after another morning wasted like this. Is it so difficult to find a job? The phone calls all morning were full, no one would be so cheating! Could it be that those guys were just trying to deal with him? Well, do we have to go to the door to apply for the job in person to show sincerity? If this is the case, then why do these companies still post so many recruitment information? !
Thinking of this, Lin Zheng was suddenly filled with resentment, and just when Lin Zheng was complaining, there was a "click!" and the door was opened. "Xiao Linzi! Come and help!" Suddenly a shout came from the door. Lin Zheng put down the newspaper and walked over. He saw a man standing at the door whose face was blocked by boxes. There were a lot of things piled at the door, including a lot of convenience foods and various daily necessities.
"Are you preparing to hibernate or practice in seclusion, you rogue? It's too early to hibernate, it's June now!?" Lin Zheng said, staring at the things on the ground speechlessly.
As Lin Zheng helped take the two boxes, a fair face appeared in front of Lin Zheng. This was a beautiful face that looked full of youthful vitality. At this time, her face was panting with excitement. This appearance definitely destroyed her own image completely! Just like Lin Zheng shouted, she really looks more like a female gangster than a lady at this moment! She is Yang Qi, the good sister who lives with Lin Zheng! Since Lin Zheng's various behaviors are really not related to a lady, and he often utters gangster quotes from time to time, Lin Zheng has the nickname "female gangster" in his mouth, or gangster for short! This kind of nickname would definitely make other girls furious, but what left Lin Zheng speechless was that this female gangster didn't care!
Yang Qi rolled her eyes, "Stop talking nonsense and help move the things quickly. You will know later!" Although he was speechless, Lin Zheng still helped move the things into the house. After moving the things, Yang Qi immediately got into the sofa and gasped. She opened a can of juice and started drinking. Then she let out a long burp without paying any attention to her appearance.
"I'm really exhausted this morning!" Yang Qi gasped, "You don't know! There were so many people in the specialty store that they almost squeezed me into a meat pie! But, hehe - hehe -"
"Okay, you'd better get your breath better first!" Looking at Yang Qi's almost breathless appearance, Lin Zheng was really worried that she would faint before she could take a breath.
"As for that? What did you go shopping for and you're so tired? By the way..." Lin Zheng glanced at Yang Qi's golden-proportioned figure, "This person is crowded, aren't you afraid of being eaten by others?!"
"Hmph - the guy who dares to eat my aunt's tofu has not yet been born!" Yang Qi said proudly. In an instant, Lin Zheng's mind showed some miserable perverts who were hit by their vaginal legs. It can be predicted that there will definitely be unlucky guys when Yang Qi goes out this time! Amitabha! I hope we don’t make people inhumane!
Lin Zheng held a moment of silence for half a second for those perverts who wanted to eat the female gangsters. "The heroine is mighty! But what on earth did you buy?!"
"Of course it's a good thing!" Yang Qi took another sip of juice, her anger was relieved, and then she proudly said to Lin Zheng: "Do you know the game I played?"
"The game you play? "Phantom"? I know! Isn't it closed down?" Lin Zheng looked confused.
Yang Qi slapped her thigh and said excitedly: "It's time!"
"Are you stupid? You look pretty stupid like this!" Lin Zheng couldn't help but complain.
"Your sister!" Yang Qi vomited blood, rolled her eyes and said, "What I mean is that "Phantom Spirit 2" is released.Coming! "
"oh? Lin Zheng was a little surprised, "How long has it been since it closed down, and the second generation has come out?" How does it compare to the Japs' "Fantasy"? "
"No comparison! "
"Then what's the point? Why bring it out if you can't compare? ! "
"hey-hey! Yang Qi smiled proudly, "This time it's the other way around!" I really want to see the reaction of those little devil operators! Wow haha! It’s fun just thinking about it! I won’t pay them to death this time! "
"oh! So awesome! Lin Zheng also became interested, "Tell me, what's going on in "Phantom 2"!" ? "
“Two words, ‘real’! "Yang Qi said, "The first generation still had an animation style. Of course, our country's animation level was only crushed, but the new system that came out this time has a super-realistic style. Well, it's basically like traveling to another world! Nothing compares to anime! No, I ran out early in the morning and bought the login device! "After that, Yang Qi proudly pointed to the two boxes that had just been moved into the house. And after listening to Yang Qi's words, Lin Zheng also figured out what was going on.
